caption: The drawing depicts a brown upholstered couch with ornately carved wooden armrests and side panels. Draped across the entire couch is a large quilt featuring a geometric, diamond-shaped pattern made up of small squares in red, green, blue, yellow, and white, bordered by green and white edges. On the left side of the couch, in the foreground, there are several distinct swatches or pieces of fabric with different textures, colors, and patterns. One fabric piece is bright red with a jagged edge. Beneath it is a white cloth with a red geometric lattice or diamond pattern. Lower left are green and black fabric and a small, square blue knitted swatch. There is also a pale yellow swatch, partly covered by the others. The background is a plain, off-white color with no other visible objects or designs.
title: Quilts - Pieced
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
